info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Capacity Registry Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Creates a capacity policy (a limit, a warning and a critical utilisation, a trend window, a forecast horizon and a reporting interval), reads and lists it with filters, reports samples a day apart (and the same moment again: 200, the stored sample, nothing overwritten), and shows how the policy judges itself when read: no data, OK, the latest sample that does not move back with a late report, a straight-line forecast of 4 days to the limit and the date it would run out, CRITICAL after the limit is tightened, a paused policy not judged, and a tool that went silent marked stale. It updates the definition, pauses and resumes, lists samples newest first with a limit, and reads the audit ledger in order. A second folder proves the registry is staff only (a REQUESTER gets 403 ERR-CAP-00403 on every route). A third covers the negative guarantees: validation (blank or long name, missing asset, metric or limit, numbers out of range, a critical level not above the warning one, an unknown metric that is never repeated in the answer, malformed identifiers, missing tenant or executor), duplicate names (409) on create and on rename, illegal transitions, updating a paused policy, samples that make no sense (negative, missing, in the future), a sample for a policy that is not the tenant's, tenant isolation, the limits of the sample list, and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files everything under its own generated tenant id (capOrganisationId). The race of simultaneous reports of one sample, the latest sample that only moves forward, two people pausing at once and the ledger are proved by the platform smoke (capacity-smoke).
